reason: The current Ethereum lvlUSD/slvlUSD product is explicitly sunset. Current official homepage and linked community update state the Level protocol is winding down, no further minting or yield, and post-frontend access is unstaking/redemption only. This rejection is for Level money's Ethereum stablecoin product, not merely the older BSC leveraged-trading protocol.

observations: Banner announces the Level team is joining a leading DeFi protocol and will be sunsetting the product.
The banner links the official Level community update.
States Level team is joining the Sky ecosystem as part of Grove.
Explicitly says Level protocol, including lvlUSD and slvlUSD, will be sunset.
Final yield distribution October 2, 2025; no yield after that date even if staked.
Frontend maintained until December 15, 2025, then users can interact with contracts to unstake and redeem.
Mints paused, redemption rates fixed 1:1 and public redemption offered; these exit-only functions do not override lifecycle exclusion.
Provides Ethereum LevelMinting 0x9136aB0294986267b71BeED86A75eeb3336d09E1 and initiateRedeem/completeRedeem instructions as integrator exit handling.

limits: Lifecycle rejection precedes deployment ABI admission. No complete ABI inventory or current implementation identity is asserted for the rejected target.
The exact dates and exit terms above are announcement statements, not runtime state, balances, claim availability or successful-execution attestations.
Acquisition of the team does not make the sunset Level product maintained, nor authorize admitting Grove or Sky a second time.
